Players Committee card image of [[Hondo Ohnaka (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. While at Audience Chamber (or stacked on your Objective), your other Weequays are deploy -1, power +1, and forfeit +2. Once per game, may deploy Aurra, Slave I, or a Kowakian from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/hondoohnaka_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e083be48ab147a9c9a69d055ec2467a29b3f0225 e083be4] (24 January 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
